patch.replace:
"\"$RUNTIME_ROOT/venv/bin/python\" -m pip check",
        "SYSTEM_ROOT=\"$RUNTIME_ROOT/system\"",
        "mkdir -p \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/bin\" \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/lib\"",
        "test -x /usr/bin/ffmpeg && test -x /usr/bin/ffprobe",
        "cp -L /usr/bin/ffmpeg /usr/bin/ffprobe \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/\"",
        "ldd /usr/bin/ffmpeg /usr/bin/ffprobe | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^\\//) print $i}' | sort -u | while read -r lib; do test -f \"$lib\" && cp -L \"$lib\" \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/lib/\"; done",
        "test -x \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/ffmpeg\" && test -x \"$SYSTEM_ROOT/bin/ffprobe\"",
